subtitles.zh: 新任CEO在过去一年明确表示公司将进行并购。
subtitles.en: I mean, the CEO who came in recently, over the past year or so, had been very clear that the company is going to be doing M&A.

subtitles.zh: 原因在于他们有一款药dopixant，最初用于特应性皮炎、湿疹，但显然还有更严重的适应症。
subtitles.en: Why? Because they have one drug, dopixant, which is first was developed for atopic dermatitis, eczema, but you know, obviously more serious versions of it.

subtitles.zh: 此外，它还适用于肺部、哮喘、慢阻肺或肺气肿等疾病。
subtitles.en: And then also it's got applications for lung, asthma, COPD or these, you know, emphysema, et cetera.

subtitles.zh: 根据市场共识和我们对该药的看法，它将贡献一半的收入，尽管利润占比没那么高，
subtitles.en: And if you look at the consensus and our own view of the drug, it's going to be half of the revenue, although it's not as much of the profits,

subtitles.zh: 因为它将50%返还给general。所以，你不想让一家公司如此暴露。
subtitles.en: because it gives 50% of that back to the general. So they, you know, you don't want to leave a company to be that exposed.

subtitles.zh: 而且该产品在某个时点，我们认为比专利实际声明的时间更晚，主要专利将面临仿制药竞争。
subtitles.en: And also it's a product that, at some point, according to us later than what the patent actually says, the main patent, is going to go generic.

subtitles.zh: 因此需要填补这一缺口，而Insmed在这里非常合适。
subtitles.en: So you need to fill that back up and eninsment is a pretty good fit here.

subtitles.zh: 它主要是一家呼吸业务公司，与他们所在的呼吸应用领域紧密契合。
subtitles.en: It's a respiratory business, mostly, a fist with the respiratory applications that they're in.

subtitles.zh: 所以非常匹配，这正是公司所需要的。
subtitles.en: So it really fits very well. And it's exactly what the company needed.

subtitles.zh: 所以当我描述估值时，我说要求很高。支付的价格要求很高。
subtitles.en: So when I was describing the valuation is demanding. The price being paid is demanding.

subtitles.zh: 你会怎么描述？当买家必须买时，对方可能会要价更高。
subtitles.en: How would you describe it? Well, when you're a buyer that needs to buy, I think people can potentially ask for more.

subtitles.zh: 我不确定这是不是需求。他们债务倍数将略超四倍，可能稍低。
subtitles.en: I'm not sure if it's demand. I mean, you know, they're going to just over four times, maybe a bit down in terms of debt multiple.

subtitles.zh: 他们每年将产生100到110亿欧元现金。
subtitles.en: They're going to be generating 10, 11 billion euros of cash per year.

subtitles.zh: 部分资金当然会用于其他用途，如资本支出等，但这是经营现金流。
subtitles.en: So some of that will go to other uses, of course, CapEx and et cetera, et cetera, but it's operating pretty cash flow.

Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.

Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.

呼吸领域布局补强 估值与债务压力受关注

subtitles.zh: 新任CEO在过去一年明确表示公司将进行并购。
subtitles.en: I mean, the CEO who came in recently, over the past year or so, had been very clear that the company is going to be doing M&A.

subtitles.zh: 原因在于他们有一款药dopixant，最初用于特应性皮炎、湿疹，但显然还有更严重的适应症。
subtitles.en: Why? Because they have one drug, dopixant, which is first was developed for atopic dermatitis, eczema, but you know, obviously more serious versions of it.

subtitles.zh: 此外，它还适用于肺部、哮喘、慢阻肺或肺气肿等疾病。
subtitles.en: And then also it's got applications for lung, asthma, COPD or these, you know, emphysema, et cetera.

subtitles.zh: 根据市场共识和我们对该药的看法，它将贡献一半的收入，尽管利润占比没那么高，
subtitles.en: And if you look at the consensus and our own view of the drug, it's going to be half of the revenue, although it's not as much of the profits,

subtitles.zh: 因为它将50%返还给general。所以，你不想让一家公司如此暴露。
subtitles.en: because it gives 50% of that back to the general. So they, you know, you don't want to leave a company to be that exposed.

subtitles.zh: 而且该产品在某个时点，我们认为比专利实际声明的时间更晚，主要专利将面临仿制药竞争。
subtitles.en: And also it's a product that, at some point, according to us later than what the patent actually says, the main patent, is going to go generic.

subtitles.zh: 因此需要填补这一缺口，而Insmed在这里非常合适。
subtitles.en: So you need to fill that back up and eninsment is a pretty good fit here.

subtitles.zh: 它主要是一家呼吸业务公司，与他们所在的呼吸应用领域紧密契合。
subtitles.en: It's a respiratory business, mostly, a fist with the respiratory applications that they're in.

subtitles.zh: 所以非常匹配，这正是公司所需要的。
subtitles.en: So it really fits very well. And it's exactly what the company needed.

subtitles.zh: 所以当我描述估值时，我说要求很高。支付的价格要求很高。
subtitles.en: So when I was describing the valuation is demanding. The price being paid is demanding.

subtitles.zh: 你会怎么描述？当买家必须买时，对方可能会要价更高。
subtitles.en: How would you describe it? Well, when you're a buyer that needs to buy, I think people can potentially ask for more.

subtitles.zh: 我不确定这是不是需求。他们债务倍数将略超四倍，可能稍低。
subtitles.en: I'm not sure if it's demand. I mean, you know, they're going to just over four times, maybe a bit down in terms of debt multiple.

subtitles.zh: 他们每年将产生100到110亿欧元现金。
subtitles.en: They're going to be generating 10, 11 billion euros of cash per year.

subtitles.zh: 部分资金当然会用于其他用途，如资本支出等，但这是经营现金流。
subtitles.en: So some of that will go to other uses, of course, CapEx and et cetera, et cetera, but it's operating pretty cash flow.
